articles.summary: Hey Zenitheans, As we look towards a more sustainable vision for Zenith, we’ve reviewed the number of shards currently online. We found a handful of shards go unused in comparison to others, and have decided to retire these shards during the release of Season 4 in August 2024 (release window TBA). Reminder: Accounts and characters aren’t locked to any shard or region, so no progress or data will be lost. We hope this will help consolidate players across the shards and make the experience better for everyone! TLC Shards that are retiring 🛑 US-EAST Armageddon US-WEST Protector EUROPE Dragonfruit TLC Shards that will remain up ✅ US-EAST Aether Arboruht Radiant US-WEST Acolyte Crimson Soulless (PlayStation only) EUROPE Defender Titan ASIA Nexus OCEANIA Tidekeeper Edit 7/26: Note the shard list is subject to further changes after this round of consolidation. We'll let players know in advance of any further changes.
articles.title: Updates to Shard List
